issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI: three CapturePanelModelTests override/bare-x submit argv assertions fail after batch 4's capture argv change
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). Proposed by the bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5 lander while confirming bob-cli-b7 on macOS CI.

GitHub Actions CI run 40095658827 on bob-mac-capture master 6d41b2e (the b7 fix) runs 2938 tests and fails exactly three, all in CapturePanelModelTests:

- CapturePanelModelTests.swift:2472 testBareXSelectionPreviewSubmitsUntouchedDraft: XCTAssertTrue failed - "x*!2" (the submit-argv assertion `argv=capture --format json --refuse-override -- x*!2`; the x*, x!, and x*2 iterations pass)
- CapturePanelModelTests.swift:3260 testOverrideRestartLivePreviewAndSubmitUseRestartArgvFooterAndStatus: XCTAssertTrue failed (`argv=capture --format json -- =` not in the fake-bob record)
- CapturePanelModelTests.swift:3359 testUnpreviewedOverrideRefusalKeepsDraftAndSecondReturnCommits: XCTAssertTrue failed (`argv=capture --format json -- =` not in the record)

The same three also failed on the previous SHA 54131b1 (run 40090432753, 6 failures = these 3 + the 3 b7 RefsLibraryTests). 54131b1 is the bob-cli-an.6.6.6 (batch 4) finish tale that made Mac model tests omit --require-pull-in-choice without positive pull_in capability. Batch 4's land audit recorded 21 such capture argv failures on 8400bd3 (run 40086037387); the finish tale fixed 18 and these 3 remain. Batch 4 is closed, and its closeout claimed only an AppKit typecheck on the Mac, not an XCTest run, so the remainder went unrecorded.

Root cause not confirmed. Tests/Fixtures/fake-bob emits no pull_in capability, so the --require-pull-in-choice gate is probably not the cause. Look at how the submit argv and the fake-bob record differ for the `=` override-restart and `x*!2` drafts after 54131b1 (refuse-override fallback, guard fallback, or the fake-bob write branches near lines 227-265 and 3852-3880). Do not weaken the assertions to pass with a missing write argv.

Validate on the Mac with the AGENTS.md scratch flow (rsync without .build/.git, bundle.sh, then run the CapturePanelModelTests XCTests; a typecheck is not enough), then confirm macOS CI.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same three nodes fail with the same assertion lines on two consecutive SHAs (54131b1 run 40090432753 and 6d41b2e run 40095658827). They are fast assertion failures (0.2-0.7s), not waitUntil timeouts, and the rest of the 2938-test suite passes.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5 lander found these three deterministic failures still red on the landed b7 SHA, and no task owned them. Batch 4 left them behind and is already closed.
